# appsignal_status_page (Resource)

A public status page of an AppSignal organization, showing uptime monitors. AppSignal only accepts the hostname once it has a CNAME record pointing to `cname.appsignal-status.com`, so create that record first (and make this resource depend on it).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appsignal_status_page" "public" {
  organization_slug  = "example"
  hostname           = "status.example.com" # needs a CNAME to cname.appsignal-status.com first
  title              = "Example status"
  threshold          = 1
  uptime_monitor_ids = [appsignal_uptime_monitor.homepage.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) Hostname the page is served on, such as `status.example.com`. Changing it replaces the page.
- `organization_slug` (String)
- `threshold` (Number) Minimum threshold for considering a service down, as AppSignal describes it. At least 1.
- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `uptime_monitor_ids` (Set of String) Uptime monitors shown on the page. They may belong to any app of the organization.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import appsignal_status_page.public <organization_slug>/<status_page_id>
```
